audience: marketers and agencies who track calls, forms and other leads with WhatConverts

useCases.title: Count leads by type and source for a period
useCases.text: The AI lists leads in a date range (calls, web forms, chats, texts and more) with source, medium, campaign and keyword. It groups and counts them for you.

useCases.title: Open one lead with its full details
useCases.text: The AI reads a lead with attribution, landing page, contact details, quote and sales value, and form or message content.

useCases.title: Read a phone call's transcript and recording links
useCases.text: The AI gets the duration, answer status, tracking and caller numbers, transcripts and links to the recording or voicemail. It returns links and text, not audio.

useCases.title: Review tracking phone numbers and web forms
useCases.text: The AI lists call-tracking numbers with destination, call flow and trigger, and the web forms that WhatConverts tracks.

useCases.title: Add a lead or update a lead's value
useCases.text: The AI adds a lead, such as an offline call or a sale from another system, or changes the quote value, sales value or quotable state of a lead.

useCases.title: List an agency's accounts, profiles, users and roles
useCases.text: With an agency key, the AI lists client accounts and their profiles, users and roles. You can use the ids to filter leads.
